description: NaC₂PN₃H₃O₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.60 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two N and one O atom. There is one shorter (1.36 Å) and one longer (1.38 Å) C-N bond length. The C-O bond length is 1.25 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two N and one O atom. There is one shorter (1.36 Å) and one longer (1.38 Å) C-N bond length. The C-O bond length is 1.25 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to two N and two O atoms. Both P-N bond lengths are 1.71 Å. There is one shorter (1.50 Å) and one longer (1.51 Å) P-O bond length. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one C, one P, and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one C, one P, and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.04 Å. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two C and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.02 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
